references.text: The preceding verse describing that the land shall be divided by casting lots among the tribes
Reiterates the principle that the land shall be divided by casting lots, where large tribes receive a larger inheritance and small tribes receive less
Moses commands that the land shall be divided by casting lots to the nine and a half tribes
The fulfillment of casting lots in the division of the land under Joshua
Joshua casts lots for the remaining tribes to divide the land
The lot is cast into the lap, but the decision comes from the Lord - the principle behind casting lots
Paul refers to how God divided the land among the tribes of Israel as an inheritance
